conditions.application: Separate profiling package for frame samples. The user subsequently authorized installation of the matching final production-package APK and a cold restart; package SHA-256 was verified on-device.
conditions.save_store: Isolated in-memory store; game snapshot JSON encoding is exercised.
conditions.percentile_method: Sort samples; use rounded index ((count - 1) * percentile).
conditions.slowest_thread_ms: max(buildDuration, rasterDuration) for each recorded frame.
conditions.jank_60hz: Number of recorded frames with slowest_thread_ms > 1000 / 60.
conditions.jank_30hz: Number of recorded frames with slowest_thread_ms > 1000 / 30.

current_palette.material: Original lattice file retained, rendered with cached shadow-lift body color transform and lighter soft/blocked edge shadows. Square icons and original alpha preserved; exact coincident static cards/seams render once; motion layers retain every moving tile.

conditions.current_palette_scope: Current samples use seeded multi-basin main contours with true full-depth channels/holes, ordinary edge stacks and a buried capacity proof, brightened cached material, continuous 220ms board/flight/reserve reveal and exact-rectangle static overdraw culling. Landscape preserves all geometric overlaps through rigid island reflow.
conditions.visual_completion: All six scenes per run require on_presentation_busy_changed=false after their completion window.

tile_geometry.landing: Independent C1-continuous center and size interpolation; uniform shrinking between board, tray and compact reserve.

conditions.orientation_method: The isolated benchmark changes its own preferred activity orientation; no global orientation settings are changed by the benchmark.

single_cpu_after.method: The profiling process calls libc sched_setaffinity for each of its own /proc/self/task threads; later threads inherit the affinity mask.
single_cpu_after.limitation: CPU affinity pressure on Xiaomi 17 is not an emulation or a measurement of a Transsion handset.

limitations: The baseline and after values are individual reproducible runs, not a statistical device population.
Measurements cover the real game scene and engine in an isolated package after asset warmup; other production pages, native audio and GetStorage whole-box disk flush are outside these frame samples.
FrameTiming thread budget exceedances do not directly count every missed display presentation deadline.
Historical baseline and current runs also differ in palette size and difficulty-10 core inventory; comparisons do not isolate the effect of one rendering change.
No physical Transsion handset was available. Single-CPU affinity on Xiaomi 17 is a pressure test, not a substitute for testing that handset.

reproduce.completion: The collector exits at TILE_QUEST_PROFILE_DONE, with a 120-second timeout.
